prompts.name: visitor-02-walk-sheet
prompts.prompt: Animation spritesheet on TRANSPARENT alpha. Reference identity is ONLY the SECOND person from LEFT: young adult Korean man with wavy short black hair, sage green bomber jacket over dark charcoal t-shirt, olive cargo pants and grey sneakers. Exactly EIGHT full-body poses of the SAME man, 4 columns by 2 rows, one person centred each equal cell, feet same baseline, same body size, generous cell padding. Natural WALK IN PLACE toward screen RIGHT in three-quarter side view: left contact, down, passing, up, right contact, down, passing, up. Clear DIFFERENT alternating leg positions and reciprocal arm swing, hands out of pockets, subtle jacket movement, stable face. Consistent front-side view not turning. Photorealistic cutouts, neutral lighting, not anime or illustrated. No other people, no background, no floor, no cast shadows, no grid lines, no labels, no text, no overlapping bodies, no clipped feet or heads. Wide 3:2 sheet.

prompts.name: visitor-03-walk-sheet
prompts.prompt: Create a game WALK CYCLE production spritesheet, actual transparent alpha background. Reference ONLY the third person from left: adult Korean woman with long black hair, sage-grey knit cardigan over ivory top, charcoal jeans and white sneakers. SAME character exactly EIGHT poses arranged 4 columns x 2 rows, generous margins, no overlap. Each complete head-to-toe person at identical scale and foot baseline within cell. Walking in place toward right, gentle 3/4 side view, neutral face: 1 left foot forward/right back; 2 weight down; 3 right foot passing left; 4 right knee lifted; 5 right foot forward/left back; 6 weight down; 7 left passing right; 8 left knee lifted. Natural reciprocal arm swing, restrained hair motion; anatomical leg phases clearly different, maintain face and outfit. Realistic softly lit 3D-like photographic cutouts, not cartoons. Hands no longer clasped. No background, floor, contact shadow, labels, dividers, text or extra people. 3:2 landscape canvas.

prompts.name: visitor-04-walk-sheet
prompts.prompt: Production eight-phase walking spritesheet on transparent alpha background, 4 columns 2 rows, equal cells. Use ONLY fourth person at far right of supplied reference: middle-aged Korean man, short salt and pepper hair, charcoal long coat over dark green sweater, dark trousers, black leather shoes. EXACT same man, consistent body height, face and clothing in all eight full-body cutouts. Walk IN PLACE towards screen RIGHT in 3/4 side view, ordinary restrained slow walking, realistic reciprocal arm swing and alternating feet, hands out of pockets. Clear 8 successive phases: left contact, recoil, passing, rising, right contact, recoil, passing, rising. Do NOT lift knees higher than normal walking, do not march. Heads and feet fully within each cell, equal baseline, wide padding. No other characters, no floor, no cast shadows, no background, no gridlines, no lettering or numbers. Realistic neutral soft photographic lighting, clean silhouette ready for game compositing. 3:2 landscape sheet.

prompts.name: props-sheet
prompts.prompt: Production game prop atlas on genuine TRANSPARENT alpha. Exactly SIX isolated photorealistic objects in strict 3 columns x 2 rows with generous transparent margins and equal cells, one object per cell. Top row left: plain charcoal baseball cap seen slight 3/4 front. Top middle: CLOSED folded black umbrella with curved handle, full length visible. Top right: plain white disposable face mask front view with loops. Bottom left: black unbranded smartphone held upright orientation, screen blank dark with soft green reflection. Bottom middle: small sealed kraft cardboard parcel box front 3/4 view, plain blank label with no writing. Bottom right: one plain dark work glove with all five fingers extended, palm facing camera. Cohesive realistic worn everyday Korean apartment visitor objects, neutral studio lighting, no people or hands outside glove, no text, logos or numerals, no shadows on ground, no decorative effects. All objects complete and separated, no overlap. 3:2 landscape canvas.
